# Systematic debugging (synthetic fixture)

FIXTURE_DEBUGGING_BODY

Phase 1: reproduce the failure and read the whole error.
Phase 2: compare with a working example.
Phase 3: form one hypothesis and test it minimally.
Phase 4: write a failing test, then fix the root cause.

The checklist is in references/x.md.
